name: Loldex
desc: For our PHP class, we had to do a sorta pokedex, we were free to choose what data we could use, so i decide to use ddragon, the free api from riot for League of Legends. It's a very basic web app with every champs, their details and every item with their details too. I will probably do an update version with better ux ui design in the future

name: E-commerce
desc: For our symfony class, we had to do an e-commerce platform without the payment, for logic reasons (we didn't want to pay for a school project). We had to make different roles, manage the cart, adding, modifying and deleting carts, products and user
